propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier system prompts must share a byte-identical prefix containing the full plan to enable Anthropic's whole-block cache reuse within and across runs.
The shared prefix is single-sourced as prompts.SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE + plan material (in shared_plan_prefix()) to prevent template drift and enforce structural invariance across renderers.

Pass-1 finder system prompt is restructured to prepend shared_plan_prefix(plan), and verifier templates replace {{plan}} + volatile marker with {{shared_prefix}} while keeping the finding listing in the user turn.

An exhaustiveness directive ("enumerate EVERY independent defect") is added to SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE to enforce completeness in incremental-depth BLOCK loops across all Pass-1 entry points (PASS_FINDER, PASS_CONTAINER, PASS_ISF).
The Pass-1 warm gate is updated to measure est_tokens(shared_plan_prefix(plan)) >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS instead of est_tokens(plan), ensuring it gates on the actual prefix bytes sent.

plan_review_verify_inputs output replaces the plan key with shared_prefix, and plan-review.yaml verify steps wire shared_prefix from verify_inputs into template rendering through the existing RunnerAgentStep generic variable merge.
